title: File organisation and naming
summary: A demonstration convention for keeping project material findable, version-aware and understandable to another team member.
contentNotice: Demonstration content for Atlas interface development; not final MOSCATELLI policy.

blocks.text: Names should help another person understand the subject, version and purpose without opening every file.

blocks.label: Rule of thumb
blocks.text: Optimise names for the colleague who did not create the file, not for the person who already knows where it is.
Use stable project or subject language first, followed by the specific asset or purpose and a meaningful version or date only when it helps distinguish working states.

items: Prefer words over unexplained personal abbreviations.
Avoid “final-final”, “new” and other labels that lose meaning over time.
Do not encode sensitive information in a filename merely for convenience.
Keep approved and working files distinguishable.

blocks.text: When a file becomes authoritative, the location and status should make that clear. Working duplicates should not be able to compete silently with an approved source.
